paragraphs.text: Daria was a young human girl from Ulgrotha whose planeswalker's spark triggered early in life. She was recruited by Urza as one of the Nine Titans .
By the time of the Invasion, Daria was described as a young-looking woman with black shoulder-length hair, her face smooth and bright, and she had a wide-eyed and sassy countenance.

In her youth, Daria was abandoned by her parents, who feared her innate powers. . Now an orphan, she was adopted and apprenticed by Taysir after he was reborn. She was the first to arrive on Corondor for the Planeswalker War . She helped convince Jared Carthalion to ascend . A year and a half later, she was trapped in an Amber Prison on the Null Moon by Tevesh Szat and Leshrac , where she remained for the duration of the Planeswalker War .
During the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria , she and Taysir joined Urza 's Nine Titans in a bid to attack Phyrexia directly. Daria was killed there when Tevesh Szat betrayed the Titans.
